REST IN PEACE TO THIS DOG’S OWNER 
In Cebu, Philippines, a loyal dog has become a heartbreaking symbol of love and loss after a devastating 6.9-magnitude earthquake.
The powerful quake and resulting landslide claimed the life of its elderly owner when their home collapsed. Neighbors say the dog was seen roaming the wreckage, tirelessly searching the ruins where the house once stood—and waiting, even after rescue teams confirmed the owner’s fate.
Videos of the dog’s loyalty and grief have gone viral, touching hearts across the world.
Our thoughts, prayers, and deepest support go out to everyone in Cebu during this painful time.
